name: Loudoun County Electrical Infrastructure Comprehensive Plan Amendments
update_frequency: One-time county decision with implementation follow-through
known_limitations: The February 2026 county action guides high-voltage corridor planning. The State Corporation Commission retains approval authority, and the action does not establish that any particular line is permitted, built, energized, or sufficient for a named load.
automation_notes: Follow county corridor guidance into SCC applications, route orders, land approvals, construction, energization, and service evidence.
